protein: VHH (camelid single-domain antibody against growth hormone), with C-terminal DDDDK-SGGGGS-His6 tag
assay_method: Indirect ELISA against plate-bound growth hormone (5 ng/well); serial dilutions 1:2 to 1:2048, HRP secondary, TMB, A450; EC50 from a four-parameter log(agonist)-response fit.
remark: Readout is the reciprocal of the EC50 the source reports, so that higher is better.
